g.text: FP/SIMD bracket variants: preemptible brackets are feasible, throughput differences are within noise

text.style: fill: #52514e; font: 9px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Redis throughput is the same across v0/A/B/B2 within the +-10% per-cell spread; the entry cost of the new brackets is 35-50 ns per bracketed hook call.
